schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to commit digests, matching the existing convention in .github/workflows.

Automerge patch and minor devDependency updates. Every dependency in this repo is a devDependency, and Renovate PRs run the full Docusaurus build (Deploy PR Preview) plus tsc and prettier --check, so a green branch is strong evidence.
For 0.x releases a minor bump is a breaking change under semver, so require review. Currently affects @easyops-cn/docusaurus-search-local and @harperfast/code-guidelines.
All ten @docusaurus/* packages publish in lockstep from facebook/docusaurus, including tsconfig, types and module-type-aliases. Any solo bump breaks the build, so they must move as one PR.
A Docusaurus minor can change rendering without failing the build, so a human should review the PR preview deployment. Docusaurus patch updates still automerge.
react and react-dom must always move together.

TypeScript 7 is a full compiler rewrite and @docusaurus/tsconfig 3.x is not validated against it. Require an explicit tick on the Dependency Dashboard before a PR is even opened, so the upgrade happens when someone is ready to drive it.
